title: Guided traffic resilience probe and rollback rehearsal flow
creator: Maya Patel
description: Goal: design a guided 'traffic probe' experience in the Redwood Console that helps engineers rehearse canary/AB rollouts and automated rollback under realistic failure modes. The flow should combine a lightweight simulator, preset failure scenarios (latency spikes, elevated error rates, model quality regressions), and a rehearsal mode that runs against a staging variant with synthetic traffic. The emphasis is on: 1) making safety gates explicit (alert thresholds, SLO margins, quarantine lanes), 2) providing clear, inspectable rollback actions (one-click revert, staged rollback, partial quarantine), and 3) surfacing observability links (token-level cost estimates, latency histograms, evaluation diffs) during the rehearsal.
acceptance_criteria: Interactive prototype demonstrates a guided 4-step rehearsal: select traffic segment -> choose failure scenario -> run probe -> review signals & choose action
Prototype shows at least three failure scenarios (latency spike, 5xx surge, quality regression) wired to realistic telemetry widgets
Rollback panel supports: immediate full revert, staged traffic taper (10 -> 0), and quarantine-only routing with one-click undo
Design includes inline explanations for each safety gate and a compact summary card that estimates incremental token cost and expected latency change
Handoff spec includes states for 'simulating', 'observing', 'action recommended', and 'rolled back' with annotated UX copy and microcopy for risk communication
Prototype accessibility review completed (keyboard flows + color contrast) and a lightweight usability test with 5 engineers showing no major blocking issues
comments: 2026-02-24 Maya Patel: Kicked off discovery. Spent time with PM and runtime eng to capture common failure modes. Key ask from runtime: keep simulation sandboxed (no production KV cache mutations) and allow synthetic traffic to be rate-limited.

2026-02-26 Liam O'Connor: Early wireframes attached. Focused on a 3-column layout: controls (left), telemetry sandbox (center), action/rollback panel (right). Highlighted need for a condensed mode for small screens.

2026-03-01 Alex Chen (Eng): Reviewed prototype. Engineering notes: simulator should prefer 'shadow traffic' when available; otherwise route to a staging variant. Need an API flag to mark rehearsal runs. Also flagged metric alignment: use the same alerting signals as production to avoid false negatives.

2026-03-03 Priya Rao (PM): Suggested adding a 'confidence meter' based on sample size and signal variance to help teams know when a probe result is statistically meaningful. Recommended deferring model-quality automations to later phase.

2026-03-06 Usability test (5 participants): Observations: participants expected a 'rehearsal checklist' before running probes; some confusion around 'quarantine' vs 'rollback' semantics. Action: add a quick help tooltip and reorder action buttons to reduce accidental full reverts.

2026-03-08 Design critique: @Design team approved overall layout but asked for clearer callouts on cost impact. Added a compact 'delta cost' widget to the action panel and a link to Optimize recommendations.
2026-03-10 Security review sync: security team confirmed rehearsal runs must never log real PII and recommended a privacy scrub flag for synthetic payloads. Added to handoff doc.

2026-03-12 Liam O'Connor: Updated prototype (Figma) with tooltips, confidence meter, and new revert confirmation flow. Ready for eng handoff; opening a follow-up ENG ticket for simulator API and sandbox guardrails.
design_decisions: Keep simulation sandboxed and opt-in: rehearsals default to staging variants or shadowing to avoid production impact
Show compact cost delta inline: small card in action panel that estimates additional token spend during the probe
Three-faceted actions: Quarantine (isolate traffic to variant), Staged Rollback (gradual taper), Full Revert (fastest safe path)
Confidence meter used to gate recommendations: require minimal sample & low variance for auto-suggested actions
Explicit privacy scrub flag for synthetic payloads to satisfy security/compliance requirements
